originalTitle: Bull market ‘has room to run’: 10 stocks to buy now
summary: Victoria Fernandez of Crossmark Global Investments, says the bull market is “not dead yet” and shares 10 stocks to buy now, including Nvidia, Broadcom, ASML and others. She also explains how much tech to own and what to expect from stocks heading into 2027.

chineseTitle: 牛市“还有运行空间”：现在值得买入的10只股票
